findings.claim: Unverified claim presented as verified: the Sources footer, repeated in artifact.md, says the editor's outputs and error messages 'were compared with a real PostgreSQL 18 server and psql on the same tables when the editor was built'. This module's evidence (sources.json, readiness.md) holds no transcript or run id for that comparison on these tables, and the cited 'current' documentation is now version 19. I had no local server, so I could not verify it. The shared simulator also accepts at least one statement a server rejects (see C2S-IUD-01).

evidence.section: PostgreSQL 19 (current): COPY reference page; its title reads "PostgreSQL: Documentation: 19: COPY", so the documentation the page checks against is version 19

findings.recommendation: Record the run as 'validated at <commit> by run <id>' with the server version and these tables, or reword the footer to say the outputs are documentation-checked, not executed. Same fix as C2S-IUD-03.
